summary: Iteration 5 (Android/mobile optimisation). Backend: test_marketplace_e2e.py 27/27 passed, then cleanup_test_data.py was run. GET /api/astrologers returns next_slot_at on every item. Responsive: Playwright ran at 320/360/375/390/412/430x844 and 1920x800 on /, /discover, /astrologers/{id}, /login, /register, /legal/terms, /account (customer) and /studio (astro1), plus /bookings/{id} at 390. scrollWidth equalled the viewport width on every page, no element overflowed, and there were 0 page errors. Hero h1 is 30px on mobile. Both hero buttons are full width and 48px tall. The mobile menu button is 44x44. Trust pillars span 20 to vw-20. Cards show availability ('Next slot …' matches next_slot_at), the 'View profile & book' CTA, rating/New and the chat rate. History on the web: home->discover (via the sheet)->profile->book dialog->booking, then pay->success->'Go to booking' returns to the booking (history -1). After that, back goes booking->profile->discover->home with no duplicate entries. Login from profile: the redirect to /login?next works, after login you return to the profile, and one back goes to /discover. Overlay-first: the synthetic Escape (the same event closeTopOverlay dispatches) closes only the topmost layer each time (sheet; sort select listbox; the birth-profile select inside the book dialog, then the dialog itself) and the route never changes. app:resume and app:reconnect keep the typed search value and show no spinner. app:resume on the booking page picked up the astrologer accept (the Pay button appeared). Forms: email inputs have type=email, autocomplete=email and inputMode=email. Passwords have current-password/new-password. min_exp has inputMode=numeric. Login fires a single request and its button is disabled while busy. Register is disabled until terms are accepted. Regression: register, logout (/auth/me returns 401 afterwards), all 7 studio tabs, astrologer accept and mock payment -> confirmed all work. Native config was reviewed statically and is correct: adjustMarginsForEdgeToEdge 'auto'; values-v35 sets windowOptOutEdgeToEdgeEnforcement=true and nv_night bar colours; targetSdk 35; adjustResize and singleTask; CapApp.addListener is called only in NativeShell (NetworkBanner uses the separate Network plugin listener).

ui_bugs.issue: Logging out while on a protected page (/account or /studio, desktop or mobile) lands on /login?next=%2Faccount instead of '/'. From a public page it correctly goes to '/'. RCA: react-router-dom 7 wraps navigation updates in startTransition. setUser(false) inside logout() renders first, at the old location, so Protected renders <Navigate to=/login?next=...> and that overrides nav('/'). Fix: call nav('/', {replace:true}) before awaiting logout(), or make Protected skip the redirect during logout.

critical_code_review_comments: handleBack, closeTopOverlay, Login nav(-1) when state.from===next, and PayPage goBack() using history idx are all correct on the web. On a cold deep link (idx 0), PayPage replaces with the booking/studio route, which is correct.
OVERLAY selector in native.js includes role=menu and listbox. Popover content (role=dialog) is also covered. A sonner toast is not an overlay, so it is correctly ignored.
useApi silent refresh keeps the stale data when a background refresh fails. Good.
